tools.name: list_cover_themes
tools.description: List the illustrated themes available for a free family cover (e.g. Superhero Family, Space Adventure). Use this to help the user pick a theme before calling start_family_cover.

tools.name: start_family_cover
tools.description: Start generating a free illustrated family cover. Validates the title, creates the cover request, and returns an uploadUrl (a photo-upload link to relay to the user) plus nextSteps guidance. A verification code is emailed to the user separately.

tools.name: resend_cover_code
tools.description: Re-send a fresh 6-digit verification code for a pending free cover (the previous code expired or was never received). Use this whenever verify_cover_email reports an expired code.

tools.name: verify_cover_email
tools.description: Verify the 6-digit code the user received by email for their free cover request. On success this may kick off generation (if the photo has already been uploaded).

tools.name: check_cover_status
tools.description: Check the status of a free family cover request. When ready, the response includes the cover image itself so it renders inline in the conversation, plus a shareUrl. Pass the ownerKey that start_family_cover returned to also get makeBookUrl for the full-book upsell (only the creator of the cover gets

tools.name: create_comic_preview
tools.description: Start a personalized comic starring the user's family (1-4 heroes). Returns an uploadUrl for the user to upload a family photo (with every hero in it), a private ownerKey, and nextSteps. List heroes in the order they stand in the photo, from left to right. An 8-page comic is offered only in lower-in

tools.name: get_comic_status
tools.description: Check a comic started with create_comic_preview. Pass the slug and the private ownerKey. Returns status (awaiting_photo, creating_preview, preview_ready, drawing, ready or failed), a link to view the comic once it exists, and nextSteps.

tools.name: purchase_comic
tools.description: Buy the full personalized comic (digital PDF, emailed) once get_comic_status reports preview_ready. Pass slug, ownerKey and the email the PDF should go to. Returns a Stripe checkoutUrl for the user to pay in their own browser — this tool never sees card details. This tool buys the digital PDF only;

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_cover_themes" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the illustrated themes available for a free family cover (e.g. Superhero Family, Space Adventure). Use this to help the user pick a theme before calling st…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
